configuration.rotation: unchanged full-width Q = D H / sqrt(128), shared across cases and group sizes
configuration.activation_group_axis: contiguous input features within each row
configuration.weight_group_axis: contiguous input features down each output column
configuration.quantizer: reference maxabs rule, codes -7 through +7, round-to-nearest ties-to-even; zero groups use scale 1

primary_endpoint.metric: paired difference in relative squared output error, rotated minus original

configuration.scope: float64 synthetic error simulation; previously inspected seeds; no model, network, GPU, memory compression, latency or throughput measurement

timing.definition: main start through computation, checks and plotting; excludes module imports and final JSON write
